newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco approves 10 percent minimum wage rise.
newsitem.headline: Morocco approves 10 percent minimum wage rise.

text.p: Morocco's government has approved a 10 percent rise in the minimum wage for the private sector, including agriculture, the MAP news agency said on Tuesday.
The decision was taken during a cabinet meeting held by Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali late on Monday, MAP said.

"The government approved the increase in the minimum wage by 10 percent to 7.98 dirhams (92 U.S. cents) per hour in the sectors of industry, trade and private business. It also set the minimum wage at 41.36 dirhams per day in the agricultural sector," the official agency said.
The average minimum wage in the private sector was around 1,500 dirhams per month before the new increase.
Morocco has an estimated 10 million-strong workforce of which 50 percent is concentrated in rural areas.
The rise followed consultations between trade unions, business associations and government officials, officials said.
